name: Sumadhura Edition
tagline: Where Bengaluru finds its English soul
overview: Sumadhura Edition brings English-inspired architecture to Whitefield — Bengaluru's most cosmopolitan district, founded in 1882 under the patronage of King Chamaraja Wodeyar X. The development is organised into wings (Ara, Aquila, Carina and more) offering Classic, Grand and Smart 2, 3 and 4-bedroom layouts, anchored by a landscaped master plan and full-scale clubhouse.
highlights: English-inspired architecture set in the heritage district of Whitefield
Classic, Grand and Smart layouts across 2, 3 and 4-bedroom homes
Double-height entrance lobby in tower and clubhouse
Elevated garden walkway with lily pond and landscaped grounds
Dedicated wellness, fitness and sports zones including turf and climbing wall
Home automation in living room and master bedroom
Dedicated EV parking (4 per tower) and car-charging provision
High-speed lifts with auto rescue device, Schindler or equivalent
amenities: Elevated garden walkway with lily pond

Internal: smooth putty finish, two coats premium emulsion for walls, acrylic emulsion for ceiling
Elegant double-height ground floor lobby in tower and clubhouse
Lounge area: Italian marble flooring
Staircases: granite flooring
Premium laminated wooden flooring in master bedroom

Toilets and balconies: good quality vitrified tiles; toilet dado up to false ceiling
Provision for softened water inlet in kitchen
Provision for sleeve chimney exhaust
Water inlet/outlet provision for washing machine and dish washer (Premium 4 BHK and 3.5 BHK only)
Wall-mounted EWC with concealed flush tank
Single lever diverter-cum-shower

Master bedroom toilet: vanity with premium CP fittings of Grohe or equivalent

Modular switches: Panasonic, Schneider or equivalent
Home automation in living room and master bedroom
USB port for C-type charging in master bedroom
Power supply: 4 BHK & 3.5 BHK – 4.5 kW, 3 BHK – 3.3 kW, 2.5 BHK – 2.5 kW, 2 BHK – 2.3 kW

Individual water meters for softened water lines

Water supply (internal & external): CPVC or UPVC pipes and fittings

Dedicated car-charging space in visitor parking

locationInfo.summary: Located in Whitefield — founded in 1882 under the patronage of King Chamaraja Wodeyar X and today Bengaluru's most cosmopolitan residential and IT district.
